title: Forensic Biology
sources_used: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Mention any four divisions of forensic biology. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Divisions of Forensic Biology: Forensic Serology, Forensic Botany, Forensic Entomology,
  • and DNA Profiling (or Wildlife Forensics/Forensic Anthropology).
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the forensic importance of amylase detection in saliva. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Amylase Detection in Saliva: Amylase is a primary enzyme in saliva; its detection serves as
  • a presumptive test to identify the presence of saliva on evidence like bite marks or cigarette
  • butts.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What colour change indicates a positive Phenolphthalein test? / [CO5]
questions.solution_html: • Phenolphthalein (Kastle-Meyer) Test: A positive result is indicated by a pink color change.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe acid digestion method for diatom extraction. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Acid Digestion for Diatoms: Treating tissue (usually bone marrow or lung) with strong acids
  • (e.g., Nitric Acid) to dissolve organic matter, leaving the silica-based diatom shells intact for
  • microscopic analysis.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe microscopic examination of fibre cross-sections. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Microscopic Fibre Cross-Sections: Fibers are embedded in a medium (like paraffin) and
  • sliced thinly to observe shapes (e.g., trilobal, circular) which help identify the fiber type and
  • manufacturing process.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Analyze significance of medullary index in species identification. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Medullary Index: The ratio of the diameter of the medulla to the diameter of the hair shaft.
  • In humans, it is usually less than $1/3$; in animals, it is typically $1/2$ or greater.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: How can stringing method help determine the point of origin? / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Stringing Method: Using strings and protractors to trace the flight paths of blood droplets
  • back to a common 3D space to find the exact location of the blow.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Why is the Benzidine test no longer preferred? / [CO5]
questions.solution_html: • Benzidine Test: No longer preferred because Benzidine is a known carcinogen.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain biochemical composition of hair. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Biochemical Composition of Hair: Primarily composed of the protein keratin, along with
  • lipids, water, and pigments (melanin).
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: What is the confirmatory test for seminal stains? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Confirmatory Test for Semen: Identification of Spermatozoa via microscopy (Christmas
  • Tree Stain) or the PSA (p30) test.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Differentiate between Point of Convergence and Point of Origin. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Convergence vs. Origin: Point of Convergence is the 2D intersection of blood drop paths on
  • a surface; Point of Origin is the 3D location in space where the blood source was located.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State what is meant by a diatom / [CO4] [2x10 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Diatom: Unicellular algae with a unique cell wall made of silica (frustule) used in the
  • diagnosis of drowning.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define collection of biological evidence. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Collection of Biological Evidence: Must emphasize preventing contamination and
  • degradation. Use of sterile swabs, air-drying samples before packaging, and using paper bags (not
  • plastic).
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the principle of Acid Phosphatase test. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Acid Phosphatase (AP) Test: Semen contains high levels of AP. The test uses a substrate that
  • turns purple in the presence of AP; it is a presumptive test for seminal stains.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Demonstrate how to extract diatoms from lung tissue for forensic examination. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Diatom Extraction from Lungs: Detailed steps involving sampling peripheral lung tissue, acid
  • digestion, centrifugation, and slide preparation.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe laboratory comparison of questioned and known fibres. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Fibre Comparison: Comparing color, diameter, delustrants, and optical properties (like
  • birefringence) between a crime scene fiber and a known source.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Analyze why diatoms are more reliable than stomach content for confirming drowning. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Diatoms vs. Stomach Content: Diatoms in closed circulatory systems (bone marrow/brain)
  • indicate the person was alive and breathing in the water, whereas stomach water can be
  • swallowed post-mortem.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the biological and physical properties of blood that influence stain formation. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Properties of Blood: Discussion of Surface Tension (maintaining spherical shape), Viscosity
  • (resistance to flow), and Specific Gravity.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the biochemical basis for identification of blood at a crime scene. / [CO5] [4x5 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Biochemical Basis of Blood Identification: Based on the peroxidase-like activity of
  • hemoglobin, which catalyzes the oxidation of a reagent to produce a color change or
  • luminescence.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the forensic significance, collection and preservation of other body fluids such as saliva, sweat and faecal matter in criminal investigations. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Saliva, Sweat, and Faeces:
  • Significance: DNA source and linking suspect to scene (e.g., masks, clothing).
  • Collection: Swabbing for saliva/sweat; bulk collection for faecal matter.
  • Preservation: Dry storage and refrigeration to prevent bacterial growth.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe detailed laboratory comparison of human and animal hair. / [CO2] [10x1 = 10]
questions.solution_html:
• Human vs. Animal Hair Comparison:
  • Cuticle: Human scales are imbricate; animals may have coronal or spinous scales.
  • Medulla: Human medulla is often absent, fragmented, or narrow; animal medulla is
  • continuous, patterned, and wide.
  • Pigmentation: Human pigment is denser toward the cuticle; animal pigment is denser
  • toward the medulla.
  • Scheme of Evaluation
  • Section Marking Criteria Marks
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
